caveat: The six issue acceptance bullets, PR #798 and PR #799 controls were reconciled; canonical extractor maps 3 normative items. Local 40 passing tests and green CI do not confer independent approval.

acceptance_criteria.text: Restrict both canonical URL forms and verify app, check, external ID, SHA; deny spoofed URLs.
Retain newly-created ID on failure and terminate it as failure.
Surface closure errors and never claim approval.
Execute positive, negative, regression tests in bootstrap CI.
Authenticated recovery of known orphaned checks without retrying failed jobs.
Keep develop as target; candidate is ready for independent review but not merged.

consolidated_pr_controls.control: Partial exact identity cannot block a terminal fail-only Check Run update
Draft PR never creates a Check Run; ready_for_review still triggers the workflow
